---
title: Ricotta and Tuna Balls
id: MAR-0061
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 150 g ricotta
- 250 g tuna in oil
- 80 g cream cheese
- 2 tablespoons fresh parsley
- 1 tablespoon capers
- 1 spring onion
- 2 egg yolks
- to taste juice and grated zest of 1 lemon
## Method
1. Salt and black pepper. Sift the ricotta into a bowl.
2. Add the cream cheese, egg yolks, and mix.
3. Add the drained and flaked tuna, the chopped capers with the spring onion, the parsley, the lemon zest, a grind of black pepper, and mix everything.
4. Adjust salt, cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
5. With the mixture, form small meatballs, arrange them on a serving plate, moisten them with lemon juice, and serve.
